BEFORE YOU PRINT

A brighter first print.

The body is hollow with a flat base. The lid has a locating lip, and the stem prints separately for easy color changes. Press its square peg into the matching lid socket after printing.

  1. Upload a bold face with a white or transparent background. Black areas cut through the front wall; enclosed islands may detach and will be flagged.
  2. Download the ZIP, extract all three STL files, and import them into your slicer in millimeters.
  3. Place the body flat on its base. Inspect overhangs around the eyes and mouth; supports may be needed. Place the lid and stem separately on the print bed. Orient each part and add supports as your printer requires.
  4. Set the recess diameter slightly larger than your LED puck and choose its depth. The base stays solid below the pocket. Use Body only and orbit above it to inspect the recess. Adjust stem size and fit clearance to suit your printer; the peg tip has a lead-in taper. Use a fit test to tune the lid clearance for your printer.

Use LED lights only. This model is plastic, not a heatproof candle holder. Mesh checks do not replace slicer inspection or a physical test print.
